freshness.warning: Treat unavailable or unknown actor access as unsupported until verified. UI-only capability is not agent-callable by implication.

human_operator.name: Interactive terminal/TUI
human_operator.summary: goose provides a CLI agent interface.

evidence.claim: goose provides a CLI agent interface.
Invocation verified: goose session, goose

human_operator.name: Desktop or web surface
human_operator.summary: goose provides an Electron desktop interface.
invocation: Goose Desktop (Electron app, downloadable per-OS installer)

evidence.claim: goose provides an Electron desktop interface.
Invocation verified: Goose Desktop (Electron app, downloadable per-OS installer)

human_operator.name: Agent-native file editing
human_operator.summary: goose can install, execute, edit, and test through agent tools.

evidence.claim: goose can install, execute, edit, and test through agent tools.
Invocation verified: write, edit, tree (developer extension tools)
goose can execute local commands.
Invocation verified: shell (developer extension tool)

human_operator.name: Headless/non-interactive execution
human_operator.summary: goose server and CLI paths support external automation.

evidence.claim: goose server and CLI paths support external automation.
Invocation verified: goose run -i <FILE>, goose run -t "<TEXT>", goose run --no-session, goose run --quiet

human_operator.name: RPC/app-server protocol
human_operator.summary: The goosed server exposes agent functionality to clients.

evidence.claim: The goosed server exposes agent functionality to clients.
Invocation verified: goose acp, goose serve --host <HOST> --port <PORT>

human_operator.name: MCP client
human_operator.summary: goose is MCP-first and can use MCP extensions and apps.

evidence.claim: goose is MCP-first and can use MCP extensions and apps.
Invocation verified: goose configure (Configure Providers/Extensions), goose session --with-extension <command>, goose session --with-streamable-http-extension <url>

human_operator.name: Agent Skills
human_operator.summary: Recipes and reusable instructions package workflows for agents.

evidence.claim: Recipes and reusable instructions package workflows for agents.
Invocation verified: goose skills list, /skills (interactive slash command)

human_operator.name: Subagents/delegation
human_operator.summary: goose supports delegated/subagent workflows through recipes and summon/delegate primitives.
invocation: natural-language delegation request (e.g. "run these in parallel using subagents")

evidence.claim: goose supports delegated/subagent workflows through recipes and summon/delegate primitives.
Invocation verified: natural-language delegation request (e.g. "run these in parallel using subagents"), GOOSE_SUBAGENT_MAX_TURNS env var

human_operator.name: Self-hosted worker/runtime
human_operator.summary: goose runs locally or on user-managed servers.

evidence.claim: goose runs locally or on user-managed servers.
Invocation verified: goose session --container <id>, goose serve (self-hosted ACP server)

human_operator.name: Model/provider portability
human_operator.summary: goose is designed to work with multiple LLM providers and local models.

evidence.claim: goose is designed to work with multiple LLM providers and local models.
Invocation verified: goose configure (Configure Providers), GOOSE_MODEL env var / config.yaml, goose run --model <MODEL> --provider <PROVIDER>
